H02-01: Match between the system and the real world
Inspection of the lang attribute on the <html> root element.
Pass: The <html> tag has a valid, non-empty lang attribute.
Fail: The lang attribute is missing or empty.
3. Flag if undefined or an empty string.
If the lang attribute is missing or empty:
- Add a valid lang attribute to the <html> tag (e.g., lang="en") to assist screen readers and search engines.
